description:
Promoted from deferral #619 of uat-disk-gate-always-on.
Deferred: Pre-cell (predictive) disk check so one oversized cell cannot fill the disk before the post-cell watch fires
Reason deferred: Needs per-cell size prediction; the advisory budget table is (platform, benchmark, scale)-keyed and could feed this, but prediction accuracy work is out of scope for a gate-wiring fix.
